positioning.oneLine: Source-qualified blockchain observation and replay infrastructure in Rust.
positioning.description: Captures exact Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and BNB Smart Chain source observations before interpretation, then replays them into chain-native facts and revision-aware serving contracts.

capabilities.claim: Preserves exact source identity and observation order through a crash-safe local WAL.
Models Bitcoin block, UTXO, observer-local mempool, replacement, and package relationships.
Provides deterministic local validation evidence for Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and BNB Smart Chain semantics.
Ships a replayable synthetic durable path through Kafka-compatible streaming, raw object archive, ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, REST, and WebSocket boundaries.

limitations: Developer preview: not a hosted service or a production mainnet deployment.
Three-region observer availability, production high availability, load, soak, and disaster-recovery gates are not yet certified.
The release bundle contains the proven Phase 0 executables; several Phase 1 processors remain under implementation.
No web or native Apple analytical client is included in version 0.1.0.
safetyBoundaries: Does not hold private keys, sign transactions, provide custody, or execute trades.
Raw observations remain source-qualified; aggregate views are not presented as an authoritative global mempool.
Local validation uses disposable loopback-only infrastructure and does not prove production security or availability.
